title: Ro Vayn Karan Babay Dat Janazay
body:
Ro vayn karan babay dat janazay tay Zahra diyan jaeyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Rehman diyan kul siftaan Haye baad e Mohammad wich kufay khoon ruwaeyan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ismillah da jado kufay wich elan hoya
Wich masjid pak namazi day kalma go ibn e muljim nay Haye zarbaan sir tay laeyaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Bay khata maar dita loka maan risalat da
Rae puchdi Zainab Ghazi nu ay das day paeyaan kyun umat babay nal veer judaeyaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aae Yasrab tou sada Zahra naal Mohammad di akhiyan cho khoon baha ronday
Sada ujreya shehar Madina aj mu pitt kay dain duhaeyaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Hoya kohram bapa torr janaza babay da Ghazi diyan bhena loko
Haye Bait ul Huzan ch ja kay inj waang ambri kurlaeyaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aeho Toseef dua aa kay laal aay Narjis da aa lain badla Mahdi
Babay di qabar tay rondiyan nay Haye maawaan dard sataeyaan.
